entries.3a829aaa557cc638: Under the corporate philosophy "To propose safe and comfortable 'living' for people and aim to realize a prosperous and healthy society," it says it will strengthen its management base with core businesses of developing and selling urban rental condominiums 1 building at a time, with Tokyo's 23 wards as the main development area, selling detached houses and townhouses in Tokyo, Kawasaki and Yokohama, and developing apartments.
